title: Admin Gateway Proxy Config
description: Schema for proxy configuration: env vars, model map, and Model Chains.

CLAUDE_MINIMAX_PROXY_PORT.description: Loopback port the proxy listens on.

MINIMAX_ENV_FILE.description: Absolute path to the .env file containing MINIMAX_API_KEY.

MINIMAX_PROXY_TOKEN_FILE.description: Absolute path to the proxy-token file used for X-Proxy-Token auth.

MINIMAX_PROXY_TOKEN_DISABLED.description: Set to '1' or true only in dev to skip token auth. Production must be false.

MINIMAX_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES.description: Hard cap on cache entries (naive LRU eviction).

model_map.description: Picker slot → MiniMax model mapping (Claude Desktop registry uses Anthropic-looking names).

model_chains.description: Per-picker Model Chains waterfall. First model is primary; subsequent are fallbacks tried in order.
